en.html:
Moriuji"...Then, Your Highness, Prince Maidono. For the Sword-Offering Ceremony I shall now proceed to Hachiman Shrine."
Moriuji"Fudaraku in my absence, and the reception of Lord Kujou, envoy for the imperial offerings—these matters I am leaving in Your Highness's most capable hands."
Prince Maidono"Ah, haan. Your side also, you look after it properly, Rikufu."
Moriuji"Indeed. I shall pray for a hundred years of prosperity for the nation."
Prince Maidono"Very good, very good. Such prayers we can always use."
Moriuji"At the risk of immodesty, this Rikufu considers himself the main pillar of our divine land of Yamato. Whatever service the nation requires, neglecting it is not in my nature. A pillar cannot take leave from holding up the roof."
Prince Maidono"...Haan, I know. Your wholehearted loyalty, Rikufu, very well I know it."
Moriuji"Your words honor me."
Moriuji"Then one such duty I shall discharge immediately, with Your Highness's presence most respectfully borrowed for the purpose. Unpleasant business, yes. But duty does not consult our pleasure."
Prince Maidono"...Kya? What business?"
Moriuji"Raichou."
Raichou"Yes, Father."

ja.html:
護氏「……然らば、舞殿宮殿下。 　これより太刀奉納の儀のため八幡宮へ赴き ますゆえ」
護氏「普陀楽の留守と奉幣使九条殿の饗応、何卒 宜しくお頼み申します」
舞殿宮「あぁ、うん。 　そっちも宜しゅうにな、六府りくふ」
護氏「はっ。 　国家百年の繁栄を祈願して参りましょう」
舞殿宮「そらええことやなァ」
護氏「憚りながらこの六府、神州大和の大黒柱を 自ら任じてござれば…… 　国家のためのいかなる務めであろうと怠る つもりは毛頭ございませぬ」
舞殿宮「……あぁ、ようわかってる。 　六府の赤心忠義は、ようくわかってますえ」
護氏「畏れ入ります」
護氏「されば早速、これより宮殿下の御前を拝借 して、我が務めの一つを果たしましょうぞ。 　楽しからぬ仕儀なれど、是非もなし」
舞殿宮「……なんやて？」
護氏「雷蝶」
雷蝶「はい、お父様」

en.html:
Aide Kaneko"Y... Your Highness..."
Prince Maidono"Kaneko!? You, here—how...?"
Prince Maidono"What is the meaning of this, Rikufu!"
Moriuji"...Quite so. Naturally, Your Highness will be knowing nothing about this."
Moriuji"Serving at Your Highness's very elbow, this namak-haram went and joined the remnants of that rebel Okabe. And the bloody bastard's ambition did not stop there. Into his treason he intended to drag Your Highness also!"
Prince Maidono"————"
Aide Kaneko"..."
Moriuji"For Your Highness, this must be a thunderbolt out of a clear sky. Unfortunately, the material evidence is already in our hands. For doubt there is no accommodation left—"
Moriuji"Your distress, Your Highness, I can fully appreciate."
Prince Maidono"..."
Raichou"Arre? His Highness Prince Maidono is not looking very surprised, na."
Raichou"Already you were knowing, perhaps...? Just a possibility I am asking about."
Prince Maidono"N-no..."
Moriuji"Nonsense you are talking, Raichou. A personage such as His Highness, knowingly keeping a traitor at his side? Impossible. His standing does not permit the possibility."
Moriuji"...Is that not so, Your Highness?"
Prince Maidono"............"
Raichou"Uf... fufufu..."
Aide Kaneko"Nothing to do with His Highness! He knows nothing! Whether he wished to overthrow the shogunate, that I was trying to find out. Nothing I achieved, and now look at my condition...!"
Aide Kaneko"Bitter thing to admit, but Prince Maidono is exactly the useless ornament everyone says! Innocent he is! Take my head and finish it—"
Raichou"Bas. Your mouth you will close, please."

ja.html:
側近金子「み……宮殿下……」
舞殿宮「金子!? 　おまさんがどうしてここに……」
舞殿宮「これはどういうことや、六府！」
護氏「……左様……。 　宮殿下は何もご存知ありますまい」
護氏「この者、宮殿下のお側近くに仕える用人で ありながら、逆賊岡部の残党どもと結び…… 　あろうことか、宮殿下を謀反の企みに引き 入れようとまで図っていた不逞の輩！」
舞殿宮「――――」
側近金子「……」
護氏「宮殿下には晴天の霹靂でございましょう。 　しかし、これは既に物証もあがり、事実を 疑う余地は無し――」
護氏「ご心中、お察し申し上げます」
舞殿宮「……」
雷蝶「あらぁ？ 　舞殿宮殿下、あまり驚いておられませんの ねぇ」
雷蝶「もしかして、とっくにご存知でいらっしゃ った……とか？」
舞殿宮「い、いや……」
護氏「戯けたことを申すな、雷蝶。 　舞殿宮殿下ともあろう御方が、逆賊をそれ と承知で側へ置いておかれる筈がない」
護氏「……左様でございますな？ 　宮殿下」
舞殿宮「…………」
雷蝶「ウフ、フフフッ……」
側近金子「宮殿下は無関係だ！　何もご存知ない！ 　私は宮殿下に倒幕のご意思がお有りか否か 探っていたが、何の成果もなく、このような 始末となった……！」
側近金子「無念だが、舞殿宮殿下は風聞通りの昼行灯、 潔白であられる！ 　さっさと私の首を――」
雷蝶「お黙りなさいな」

en.html:
Aide Kaneko"Gah!"
Prince Maidono"Kaneko!"
Moriuji"Your Highness. What is your answer?"
Moriuji"If this man's true character Your Highness already knew... then why such a fellow was being kept so close, that explanation I would be obliged to request."
Moriuji"Yamato's protection is my responsibility, after all. An answer I must have."
Prince Maidono"..."
Moriuji"If nothing you knew... then very simply the matter can end. Which is it, Your Highness?"
Prince Maidono"..."
Prince Maidono"I didn't know."
Moriuji"..."
Raichou"..."
Prince Maidono"Nothing I knew. Kaneko, such a scoundrel he was..."
Prince Maidono"Other people also you must drag into your mess, is it? Arre, my heart is not built for this."
Aide Kaneko"...Heh..."
Moriuji"...Then how this man is disposed of, Your Highness is content to leave entirely in our hands?"
Prince Maidono"Haan... no objection. Whatever you like, do."
Moriuji"Very good. Raichou, take him away."
Raichou"Yes."

護氏「もしも、宮殿下がこの者の本性をご存知で あられたのなら…… 　かような者をどうして側へ留め置かれたの か、仔細をお尋ねせぬわけには参りませぬ」
護氏「この護氏には大和を守る責務がありまする ゆえ」
舞殿宮「……」

舞殿宮「……」
舞殿宮「知らんえ」
護氏「……」
雷蝶「……」

舞殿宮「人を巻き込まんといてくれんかなぁ。 　心臓に悪いったらないわ」
側近金子「……フフ……」

護氏「承りました。 　雷蝶、連れてゆけ」

en.html:
Moriuji"...For traitors, this is always the destination. To see justice properly maintained in the world—what satisfaction it gives."
Prince Maidono"...Haan."
Moriuji"Those Okabe leftovers who failed even to die, soon we shall gather the whole lot and send them after him. Please wait without anxiety. This unfinished business we shall finish."
Prince Maidono"..."
Moriuji"That Your Highness had no part in such idiotic treason, this Rikufu is sincerely relieved to learn. The order of things you understand so well. Naturally, not for a moment was I entertaining suspicion—"
Moriuji"Going forward also, please keep yourself on the correct side of things."
Prince Maidono"I know, I know..."
Moriuji"Thanks to Your Highness, with a peaceful mind I can now conduct the Sword-Offering Ceremony. Then... I take my leave."
Prince Maidono"..."
Moriuji"Your Highness."
Prince Maidono"What is it?"
Moriuji"The color of the sala flowers declares that the prosperous must decline. Even the age of the arrogant is no more than a dream on a spring night."
Moriuji"—That you may keep repeating to yourself, and wait with patience. Rokuhara is not narrow-minded. Your dreams you may enjoy inside your own head. So long as they remain inside, from our side there is no objection."
Prince Maidono"............"
Moriuji"Kukukuku... Kahahahahahahahaha!"

護氏「……逆賊の末路は常にあのようなもの。 　世の正義が守られてあるは喜ばしきことに ございます」
舞殿宮「……そやな」
護氏「岡部の死に損ねも近々一網打尽に捕らまえ、 あやつめの後を追わせましょう。 　どうか安んじてお待ちあれ」
舞殿宮「……」
護氏「この六府、宮殿下が愚劣なる大逆の企てに 関わりなしと知り、心より安堵致しました。 　宮殿下は物の道理を良くわきまえた御方、 元より疑ってなどおりませなんだが――」
護氏「どうか今後とも、御身を正しく保たれます よう」
舞殿宮「わかってるよ……」
護氏「お陰をもちまして、心置きなく奉刀の儀を 執り行えまする。 　では……これにて」
舞殿宮「……」
護氏「宮殿下」
舞殿宮「何やね」
護氏「沙羅双樹の花の色は、盛者必衰の理を表す。 　驕り高ぶる者の世も、春の夜の夢に等しい」
護氏「――とでも念じて、気長に待たれるが宜し かろうと存ずる。 　六波羅は狭量にあらず、頭の中で夢を楽し まれている分には咎め立ても致しませぬゆえ」
舞殿宮「…………」
護氏「クククク…… 　カハハハハハハハハハハハッ!!」
